task_completion.description: OpenBCI GUI is launched and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenBCI GUI application window is open and active.

task_completion.description: The specific EEG recording file is selected for playback.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file path '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings/OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt' is visible in the data source or playback selection field.

task_completion.description: Channels C3 and C4 are isolated/active while others (Fp1, Fp2, P7, P8, O1, O2) are deactivated.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the channel control panel, only channels 3 and 4 (corresponding to C3 and C4) are toggled 'On' or highlighted, while channels 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, and 8 are toggled 'Off'.

task_completion.description: An 8–30 Hz bandpass filter is applied to the data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The filter settings in the GUI show a Bandpass filter selected with a frequency range of 8 Hz to 30 Hz.

task_completion.description: The FFT Plot widget is active and visible in the GUI layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window or widget labeled 'FFT Plot' is visible, showing frequency spectrum data.

task_completion.description: The session configuration is saved to the specified JSON path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' or 'Export' dialog shows the file path '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Settings/motor_imagery_config.json' or a terminal/file explorer confirmation shows the file was created at that location.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the OpenBCI GUI elements rather than just using terminal commands to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with GUI buttons, sliders, or dropdown menus within the OpenBCI application.

integrity.description: The FFT plot and Time Series show active waveforms consistent with EEG data playback, not static images.
integrity.visual_evidence: The waveforms in the Time Series and the peaks in the FFT plot change or show realistic noise/signal patterns across different timestamps.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create the JSON file via a text editor without configuring the GUI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The GUI state (channels off, filter set) matches the requirements before the save action is performed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific configuration of the OpenBCI GUI: 1. Data source must be the S001 recording file. 2. Channels 3 and 4 (C3 and C4) must be the only active channels; channels 1, 2, 5, 6, 7, and 8 must be deactivated. 3. The bandpass filter must be set to 8-30 Hz (Mu/Beta rhythm range for motor imagery). 4. The FFT Plot widget must be displayed. 5. The final output is a settings file named 'motor_imagery_config.json' in the specified Settings folder.
